subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should proactive fallback validation be the ordered mode of the existing `models status --probe` diagnostic, a dedicated CLI fallback command, or a channel-visible `/models test-fallback` command?
rationale: The existing auth probe, the broader per-model request, and this ordered-chain request overlap technically but have different safety, output, and user-surface contracts; implementing one without choosing the canonical interface would create competing diagnostics.

options.title: Unify the CLI diagnostic
options.body: Extend the existing model-status probe with an ordered fallback scope that reuses canonical candidate resolution, leaving `/models` focused on browsing and selection.

options.title: Create a fallback subcommand
options.body: Add a dedicated `openclaw models fallbacks test` CLI command with first/all modes when maintainers want fallback semantics separated from auth status.

options.title: Ship the slash command
options.body: Expose `/models test-fallback` only after defining channel authorization, token-cost warnings, timeouts, redaction, and its relationship to CLI probing.

recommendation.title: Unify the CLI diagnostic
recommendation.body: Extend the existing model-status probe with an ordered fallback scope that reuses canonical candidate resolution, leaving `/models` focused on browsing and selection.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the prior item-specific product review and have extensive recent fallback-policy and probe history.
